Project Cases

Real deployments of our prefab and container systems — resorts, site camps and developments. Every project starts with the same step: a conversation about your site.

Desert glamping camp · Capsule row + cabins

Desert Resort Deployment

Rapid deployment of capsule units in an arid desert environment. Units arrived factory-finished, were placed by crane, and connected to utilities on site — showing how prefab solves logistics-heavy remote projects.

Waterfront vacation cabins · Mixed cabin & capsule mix

Lakeside Cabin Development

A mixed development of prefab cabins and capsule units along a lakeside, each with its own deck. The project combines standard and custom models to test fast, repeatable delivery of vacation housing.

Glamping resort development · 40+ capsule units

Modular Capsule Resort Village

A full modular resort village built with space capsule houses on prepared foundations. Factory-fabricated units were delivered and crane-erected on a phased schedule, cutting on-site construction time dramatically compared with conventional building.

Eco-tourism resort · 20+ units on hillside

Quarry Lake Eco Resort

A hillside eco resort overlooking a quarry lake. Modular cabins on steel stilts follow the natural contour of the slope, with private terraces and landscaped walkways — a reference for steep-terrain prefab projects.

Tourism complex construction camp · Multi-building site camp

Amusement Park Site Camp

A multi-building prefabricated complex for a tourism development project: two-story modular buildings with blue-tiled roofs, glazed facades and fast-track construction alongside ongoing site works.

Lake-side eco lodge · 15+ elevated units

Waterfront Capsule Lodge

Elevated capsule units on stilts and wooden decking over the waterline, with full water and power hook-up. The project demonstrates our ability to handle challenging terrain and environmental constraints with minimal site impact.
